question: What are the invoice ids and statuses for invoices without a payment?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "invoices" AS SELECT "invoice_id" AS "invoice_id", "client_id" AS "client_id", "wc" AS "invoice_status" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "payments" AS SELECT "payment_id" AS "payment_id", "invoice_id" AS "invoice_id" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH invoices AS (
  SELECT CAST(invoice_id AS BIGINT) AS invoice_id,
         CAST(client_id AS BIGINT) AS client_id,
         CAST(wc AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_status
  FROM invoices
),
payments AS (
  SELECT CAST(payment_id AS BIGINT) AS payment_id,
         CAST(invoice_id AS BIGINT) AS invoice_id
  FROM payments
),
unpaid AS (
  SELECT i.invoice_id, i.invoice_status
  FROM invoices i
  LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
  WHERE p.invoice_id IS NULL
)
SELECT invoice_id, invoice_status
FROM unpaid
ORDER BY invoice_id
LIMIT 50;
